scope: Single-seed learning-rate3e-4 to6e-4 contrast with unchanged MAE, architecture, initialization, data and normalized cosine schedule. Absolute learning rates and AdamW decoupled shrinkage per step both scale with the learning rate. This identifies the complete schedule-amplitude intervention for this run, not a universal optimum; production CUDA remains nondeterministic as in the parent. Food-group intervals condition on selected checkpoints, not seed-population, label-validity or transfer uncertainty. Screening cannot accept a final model.
